paths.description: User downloads archive and extracts/runs for the first time
paths.mechanism: Electron packager output runs standalone without prior state

paths.description: Auto-updater pulls next version from same channel
paths.mechanism: electron/auto-updater.cjs checks manifest, downloads, verifies signature, swaps binary
constraints: Requires signed update manifests on darwin/win32

paths.description: User migrates from beta to stable channel
paths.mechanism: Channel preference stored in user settings; next update check uses new channel URL
constraints: Cross-channel migration is one-way (stable→beta requires opt-in)

paths.description: Auto-updater rolls back if updated binary fails health check
paths.mechanism: Previous binary kept in rollback slot; crash-reporter triggers revert
constraints: Rollback slot holds exactly one previous version

paths.description: User manually downloads previous version archive
paths.mechanism: Archives are immutable on GitHub Releases; user re-extracts

paths.description: User attempts to install older version than minimum-version policy
paths.mechanism: Auto-updater enforces minimum-version-policy; manual downgrade not blocked
constraints: Manual downgrade may cause data migration issues

paths.description: Boot from ISO, run installer to disk
paths.mechanism: os/installer/scripts/install.sh partitions and installs to A/B layout

paths.description: OTA agent pulls next bundle from channel manifest
paths.mechanism: scripts/release/supply-chain/sita-ota-agent.sh downloads, verifies signature, applies to inactive partition

paths.description: Operator switches channel in deployment profile
paths.mechanism: Channel field in /etc/sita/deployment-profile.json; next OTA poll uses new channel
constraints: Operator profile required for channel change

paths.description: Failed boot on new partition triggers A/B rollback
paths.mechanism: GRUB/systemd-boot counts failed boots; reverts to previous slot after 3 failures

paths.description: Operator triggers manual rollback via sita-ops CLI
paths.mechanism: os/bin/sita-ops rollback activates previous partition

paths.description: Forced downgrade to earlier version
paths.mechanism: Fresh re-install from older ISO; OTA does not support downgrade
constraints: Data migration not guaranteed on downgrade

paths.description: Import OVA into VMware hypervisor
paths.mechanism: Standard OVF import; first-boot provisioning via sita-first-boot.sh

paths.description: OTA agent upgrades within running VM
paths.mechanism: Same OTA path as ISO; sita-ota-agent.sh operates inside the VM

paths.description: A/B partition rollback within VM
paths.mechanism: Same A/B mechanism as ISO

paths.description: VMware snapshot rollback
paths.mechanism: Hypervisor-level snapshot/revert
constraints: Requires VMware snapshot taken before upgrade

paths.description: Full OVA re-deploy from older version
paths.mechanism: Delete VM, import older OVA
constraints: All VM state is lost on re-deploy

paths.description: dd-flash to disk or cloud import
paths.mechanism: Raw image flashed via dd or cloud console import

paths.description: OTA agent upgrades in-place
paths.mechanism: Same OTA path as ISO

paths.description: A/B partition rollback
paths.mechanism: Same A/B mechanism as ISO

paths.description: Re-flash from previous image
paths.mechanism: dd-flash older .img file
